title: How an MLP chooses an action

steps.label: Input features
steps.explanation: Represent the request and observed state as numbers. These are input signals, not executable commands.

steps.label: Hidden layers
steps.explanation: Learned weights and nonlinear transformations combine those input signals.

steps.label: Action scores
steps.explanation: The output layer assigns a score to each learned template. A template is a supported action pattern.

steps.label: Choose or abstain
steps.explanation: Use the configured acceptance rules. A score alone does not grant permission to change files.

steps.label: Validate separately
steps.explanation: Trusted code checks the proposal, arguments, authority, and current state before execution.

steps.label: Prepare content
steps.explanation: Extract source text, divide it into chunks, and retain page and version metadata. This usually happens before the user query.

steps.label: Index
steps.explanation: Store keyword-search data and compatible embedding vectors representing the content.

steps.label: Retrieve
steps.explanation: For a question, find relevant authorized chunks using words, vector similarity, or both.

steps.label: Answer or excerpt
steps.explanation: Use the evidence to form an answer. NoteEchoes active document paths return cited excerpts; a generative RAG system may synthesize an answer.

steps.label: Check and cite
steps.explanation: Validate support and freshness, return source references, or abstain when evidence is insufficient.

title: Why saving before AI protects a note

steps.label: Transcribe
steps.explanation: Convert recorded speech to text and reject meaningless input.

steps.label: Parse and save
steps.explanation: Create a usable note using the initial parsing rules. Persistence happens before optional enhancement.

steps.label: Generate enhancement
steps.explanation: Ask the local action model for structured analysis of the original transcript.

steps.label: Compare fingerprint
steps.explanation: Check whether the user edited or deleted the note while generation was running.

steps.label: Apply or discard
steps.explanation: Apply valid output only to the unchanged note. Otherwise discard the late enhancement and preserve the user edit.

title: From model proposal to controlled execution

steps.label: Request and observe
steps.explanation: Capture the user goal and relevant current state.

steps.label: Propose
steps.explanation: A model or deterministic router proposes a supported tool and arguments.

steps.label: Authorize
steps.explanation: Trusted application policy or a specific approval grants only the permitted operation.

steps.label: Revalidate and execute
steps.explanation: Check arguments and fresh state before invoking the tool. Stop if the assumptions have changed.

steps.label: Record and verify
steps.explanation: Inspect the outcome and save a receipt. Reconcile uncertain side effects before retrying.

title: How adapter training differs from inference

steps.label: Start with a base model
steps.explanation: Load pretrained weights. Quantized adapter training can keep this base frozen.

steps.label: Pair inputs and targets
steps.explanation: Prepare training examples and keep evaluation scenarios appropriately independent.

steps.label: Predict and measure loss
steps.explanation: Generate predictions and compute the configured loss on the target tokens or labels.

steps.label: Update adapters
steps.explanation: Use gradients and an optimizer to update trainable adapters. Repeat for the configured training schedule.

steps.label: Evaluate then run
steps.explanation: Evaluate the chosen artifact and deploy a compatible inference format. Ordinary inference predicts without training the weights.

steps.label: Token vectors
steps.explanation: Start with representations of the text tokens and information about their positions.

steps.label: Queries, keys, values
steps.explanation: Learn projections: queries seek relevant information, keys are matched to queries, and values carry information to combine.

steps.label: Scores and mask
steps.explanation: Compare queries with keys. In causal generation, mask future positions before normalizing scores.

steps.label: Softmax weights
steps.explanation: Turn scores into weights summing to one across the allowed positions.

steps.label: Weighted values
steps.explanation: Combine values according to those weights. Other layers further transform the resulting representation.

title: What a model score actually establishes

steps.label: Define the task
steps.explanation: Specify the fields, action, or ranking decision being measured.

steps.label: Choose independent cases
steps.explanation: Reserve representative evaluation examples; check shared templates and related sources.

steps.label: Run or inspect outputs
steps.explanation: Record whether these are fresh predictions or archived outputs being rescored.

steps.label: Score defined criteria
steps.explanation: Compute schema, selected-field, strict-match, or task metrics with the correct denominators.

steps.label: Inspect limits
steps.explanation: Review error slices and uncertainty. Output matching does not establish successful side effects or real-user outcomes.

title: Recovering a file move after a crash

steps.label: Record intent
steps.explanation: Create the prepared journal record before the safer move changes the filesystem.

steps.label: Link and verify
steps.explanation: Create the destination hard link and check its content under the supported filesystem constraints.

steps.label: Remove source name
steps.explanation: Remove the original name only after the required verification.

steps.label: Record completion
steps.explanation: Update the database. A crash between filesystem and database changes can leave an uncertain state.

steps.label: Reconcile actual state
steps.explanation: Compare real file bytes with journal evidence. Restore safely or require review rather than assume exactly-once behavior.

title: How an AI change reaches production

steps.label: Define success
steps.explanation: Agree on expected behavior, business acceptance criteria, and failure limits.

steps.label: Build and version
steps.explanation: Connect code, prompt, model, and retrieval settings to a traceable artifact.

steps.label: Test and evaluate
steps.explanation: Run software checks and representative AI regressions before accepting the change.

steps.label: Roll out gradually
steps.explanation: Release under suitable controls with a known rollback option.

steps.label: Monitor and improve
steps.explanation: Track outcome quality, errors, latency, cost, and changed inputs. Investigate the failing stage.
